work.originalTitle: 澎然心動的蘋率：30赫茲（寫真集 Vol.8）
work.summary: 蘋蘋澎澎官方網站 lists this title as photobook series Vol. 8. The creator store offers a 128-page physical single book as a 2027 preorder, with shipments expected to start in mid-December 2026. The official creator-site image is title-specific cover artwork, but has not been confirmed as the final printed cover. A limited VIP package includes high-resolution digital files on USB for the photobook and calendar; no separate standalone ebook is listed. The store does not specify an ISBN or dimensions.

edition.contentSummary: Physical 128-page single-book preorder within the 2027 VIP package; the creator store expects shipping to begin mid-December 2026. Official Vol. 8 cover artwork is available at the creator site, but final printed-cover status is not confirmed. The VIP package includes high-resolution digital files for the book and calendar on USB; no standalone ebook edition is listed. ISBN and dimensions are not specified.
